items.title: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
items.summary: FINMA waived the diversification rules for the fund but leaned hard on custody and investor-protection safeguards.

items.title: Sleeping Bitcoin Giant Moves 500 BTC Worth $41M After 10 Years of Silence
items.summary: On Tuesday, as bitcoin's price cruised comfortably above $82,000, a long-dormant wallet established on Jan. 1, 2016, stirred from its decade-long slumber, transferring 500 BTC for the first time in more than 10 years. The haul joins other recently moved coins that had long sat untouched, bringing the month's tally to 1,745.615…

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.

items.title: JPMorgan issues first long-term bitcoin return forecast, projecting 10% annually
items.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's first long-term bitcoin forecast projects a 10% annual return but flags 55% volatility as a barrier to portfolio adoption.

items.title: Bitcoin's Next Move: Here's What to Watch
items.summary: Bitcoin trades just below $83,000, above both the short-term and long-term moving averages. Here are the levels traders are watching.

items.title: Bitcoin Could Outperform Most Assets, JPMorgan Says – But the Bank Still Won't Recommend It
items.summary: The bank has said bitcoin could do better than stocks and bonds over the next 10 years but says it is still too volatile. This post Bitcoin Could Outperform Most Assets, JPMorgan Says – But the Bank Still Won't Recommend It first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin yield platform HoneyB developer raises $5 million at $30 million valuation
items.summary: Nectar Group, the developer of bitcoin income platform HoneyB, has raised $5 million in a seed funding round.

items.title: Zcash Leads Crypto Bounce, Surging 8.5% as Bitcoin Reclaims $83,000
items.summary: Zcash jumped 8.5% in 24 hours to $1,215.85 as the broader crypto market rebounded, with Bitcoin up 1.6% and ETF money flowing back in.

items.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
items.summary: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Hits $83K as Shorts Suffer $45M in Wipeouts
items.summary: Bitcoin briefly surged past $83,000 on Oct. 20, hitting a daily peak of $83,335 and pushing its market capitalization near $1.67 trillion despite volatile intraday swings between $81,200 and $82,000.
